title: Speedy Double Haloumi Tacos
subtitle: with Creamy Slaw & Caramelised Onion
description: Salty haloumi, sweet honey and smokey aioli all wrapped up in a soft tortilla shell. This meal has a bit of everything for a veggie meal that totally satisfies.

steps.text:
•

• Thinly slice brown onion. 
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. 
• Cook onion, stirring, until softened, 4-5 mins. Reduce heat to medium. 
• Stir in the balsamic vinegar, brown sugar and a splash of water. Cook until dark and sticky, 3-5 mins. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

•

• Pat haloumi dry, then slice into 1cm-thick slices.
• Wipe out frying pan and return over medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Cook haloumi, in batches, until golden brown, 1-2 mins each side.
• Remove from heat. Add the honey, turning to coat. Transfer to a plate.

•

• Meanwhile, microwave mini flour tortillas on a microwave-safe plate in 10 second bursts until warmed through. 
• In a large bowl, combine salad leaves, cabbage mix, smokey aioli and a drizzle of white wine vinegar and olive oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

•

• Fill tortillas with creamy slaw, haloumi and caramelised onions to serve.
